breaking_changes: The /models API response no longer includes image_defaults or audio_defaults keys; their values are now under recipe_options — clients reading those fields must update their read path.
Router residency conflicts now return HTTP 409 (router_residency_conflict) instead of HTTP 400 — error handlers expecting 400 will need updating.

Router policy labels are now strictly validated (unique, non-blank, no control characters); a saved policy with invalid labels will fail to load at startup and all requests return 500 — re-save or edit the policy to use valid labels.
The enable_containers config key was removed; any user or script that reads or sets it will encounter an unknown config key — remove it from your configuration.

FLM chat behavior changed: max_tokens now returns the exact requested count (one fewer than before), streamed usage is opt-in via stream_options.include_usage, and invalid requests that were silently ignored now get HTTP 400 — adjust clients that depend on the old lenient behavior.

The /files endpoint for a multi-shard GGUF model in extra_models_dir now returns one entry per shard instead of one summary entry — clients iterating the response and expecting a single main-file entry may need updating.

evidence.blockers: Three classes of items must clear before shipping: (1) the security fix for empty LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY bypass must verify the 401 paths work on the release candidate so the fix isn't broken; (2) the breaking API change removing image_defaults/audio_defaults from /models must be confirmed so downstream clients can migrate without data loss; (3) the ds4:rocm SELinux fail-closed check on Fedora must be verified so SELinux-enforcing hosts don't silently succeed when they should fail.
evidence.breaking_changes: Five breaking changes ship: the /models API removes image_defaults and audio_defaults (now under recipe_options), residency conflicts return 409 instead of 400, router policy labels are strictly validated, enable_containers config key is removed, and FLM behavior changes (max_tokens exact count, opt-in streamed usage, stricter validation). A sixth behavioral change: /files returns per-shard entries for multi-shard models. All are documented in the PR descriptions and have migration guidance.
evidence.coverage: All 56 commits from v2026.45.3..8560a81 were reviewed and their to-dos rated. The range spans container backends (llamacpp:nathanw, ds4:rocm, rocmfpx:rocm, halogen:rocm, gufo:rocm, llamacpp:halobox), new GPU targets (gfx1170/1171), decision-model endpoints (/v1/systemone, FLM on NPU, GGUF zero-shot routers), GUI features (image editing, download buttons, multi-GPU monitor, multi-column backends tab), API changes (breaking removal of image_defaults/audio_defaults, on-demand model gating, NVIDIA driver gating, empty admin key auth fix), CLI improvements (bench --submit, better 401 errors, backends info), and website updates. No commits in range lack a digest entry.
evidence.manual_testing: Release candidates should be exercised on: a Linux system with NVIDIA GPU for TheNoise CUDA and driver gating; an AMD Strix Halo machine for ds4:rocm, rocmfpx, halogen, and gufo backends; a macOS system for the restored CPU gauge; a system with multi-shard GGUF models for the /files endpoint fix; and any system with FLM NPU hardware for the decision-model endpoints. The empty admin key auth fix should be verified by starting lemond with LEMONADE_API_KEY set and LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY empty, then confirming unauthenticated requests return 401.
evidence.security: This release ships a security fix for an authentication bypass when LEMONADE_ADMIN_API_KEY is explicitly set to an empty string while LEMONADE_API_KEY is configured — the empty admin key is now treated as unset and authentication proceeds normally. This is the primary security-relevant change. No other security vulnerabilities or supply-chain concerns were observed across the 56 commits.
